content: Ligand 1 is the oxetane-cap variant; atom 0 is its pyridine 4-methyl over an acyclic bond. Two episodes left, and I am spending them on the one axis still paying: the substituent at the central-ring position ortho to the anilide. A methyl there gave +0.03, and I am testing chlorine separately this generation. A methoxy is the third distinct type - comparable in size to an ethyl, a strong pi-donor rather than an acceptor, and it lowers LogP, which from 3.2 is the direction QED wants. Together the three of them tell me whether that position responds to bulk, to electron density, or to neither, which is exactly the question left open by the methyl helping while a fluorine hurt. I pair it with the meta geometry and keep the cyclopropanecarboxamide cap, which has the best SA of the caps I measured, and a plain 4-methylpyridine. Expected product: about 297 Da.
